table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname= dbo.item.name,
	dbo.itempacking.name,
	aliasname= dbo.item.customicode,
	username=  (select username from users where users.usercode=advpurheader.usercode), 
	saleprice= (Case When ((dbo.advpurheader.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.advpurheader.purcatcode=8) OR (dbo.advpurheader.purcatcode=3)) 
							then case when (dbo.advpurheader.posted='Y') then
									 advpurdetail.saleprice/advpurdetail.packunits
								  else item.saleprice/item.packunits end
					ELSE case when (dbo.advpurheader.posted='Y') then advpurdetail.saleprice
						  else item.saleprice end 
					END) ,
	purinvcode=dbo.advpurheader.advpurinvcode,   
	netrate=dbo.advpurdetail.netrate,
	dbo.advpurheader.date ,
	dbo.advpurheader.posted,  
	dbo.advpurheader.discperc,  
	dbo.advpurheader.misccharges,  
	dbo.advpurheader.misccharges2,  
	dbo.advpurheader.flatdisc,  
	dbo.advpurheader.flatdisc2,  
	salestax=0,  
	dbo.advpurheader.suppcode,  
	dbo.advpurdetail.icode,  
	dbo.advpurdetail.batch,  
	dbo.advpurdetail.expiry,
	qty = dbo.advpurdetail.packqty + dbo.advpurdetail.looseqty,  			
	dbo.advpurdetail.bonusqty, 
	dbo.advpurdetail.packunits, 
	purprice=dbo.advpurdetail.purprice + dbo.advpurdetail.purprice2 + dbo.advpurdetail.purprice3 + dbo.advpurdetail.purprice4, 
	dbo.advpurdetail.avgprice,    
	dbo.advpurdetail.unittaxrulecode,
	dbo.advpurdetail.gstrulecode,
	dbo.advpurdetail.itemflatdisc,
	dbo.advpurdetail.itemflatdisc2,
	dbo.advpurdetail.discperc,
	dbo.advpurdetail.discperc2,
	dbo.advpurdetail.gstperc,
	dbo.advpurdetail.unitsalestax,
	dbo.advpurheader.invgstperc1,
	dbo.advpurdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	SupplierName=LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.accounts.name)),
	dbo.advpurheader.remarks,
	currqty = (case when posted='N' Then  (select sum(currqty) from godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = item.icode)
				  else advpurdetail.currstock end) / advpurdetail.packunits, 
	purtype=purchasetype.name	,
	salestax=advpurdetail.unitsalestax	,
	headerno=advpurheader.headerno	,
	dbo.advpurheader.suppinvcode,
	dbo.advpurheader.suppinvdate,
	dbo.advpurheader.GRN		,
	remainingdays=datediff(day,getdate(),advpurdetail.expiry),
	purcategory= CASE WHEN purcatcode IN (1,2) THEN   '(Pack)'
                    	WHEN purcatcode=3  THEN   '(Opening)'
							WHEN purcatcode IN (7,8) THEN  '(Loose)'
						END,
	GSTTypeCode = DBO.AdvPurDetail.GSTTypeCode,
	MeasureUnitCode = DBO.AdvPurDetail.MeasureUnitCode,
	MeasureQty = DBO.AdvPurDetail.MeasureQty,
	RetailPrice = DBO.AdvPurDetail.RetailPrice
FROM	
	dbo.advpurheader LEFT OUTER JOIN purchasetype ON (advpurheader.purtypecode = purchasetype.purtypecode), 
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.advpurdetail,
	dbo.accounts
WHERE	
	( ( dbo.advpurheader.advpurinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) ) and 
	( dbo.advpurheader.advpurinvcode = dbo.advpurdetail.advpurinvcode ) and 
	( dbo.advpurheader.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode) and 
	( advpurdetail.icode = item.icode )
ORDER BY dbo.item.name

objects.name: c_itemnetrate
objects.expression: /* (c_amount *  ( 1 -   purledger_discperc * .01 )  + (unitsalestax * ( qty  +  bonusqty )) +  Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) +( Round((Round( round(c_amount,2)   * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)) )/ (qty + bonusqty) */

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: sum((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - c_disc_after_tax) for all)

objects.name: compute_16
objects.expression: sum((itemflatdisc2 * qty) + ((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - (itemflatdisc2 * qty)) * discperc2 * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: c_salestaxval
objects.expression: unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, qty, 0) ) + if( gstperc = 0 , 0, if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ), (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), (qty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 0) )) * gstperc *  0.01)

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: sum(unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, qty, 0) ) + if( gstperc = 0 , 0, if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ), (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), (qty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 0) )) * gstperc *  0.01) for all)

objects.name: t_23
objects.visible: 1	if(sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all) + sum((itemflatdisc2 * qty) + ((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - (itemflatdisc2 * qty)) * discperc2 * 0.01) for all) > 0 AND invdiscperc > 0,1,0)

objects.name: compute_18
objects.visible: 1	if(sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all) + sum((itemflatdisc2 * qty) + ((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - (itemflatdisc2 * qty)) * discperc2 * 0.01) for all) =0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all) + sum((itemflatdisc2 * qty) + ((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - (itemflatdisc2 * qty)) * discperc2 * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: c_discounts
objects.visible: 1	if(sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all) + sum((itemflatdisc2 * qty) + ((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - (itemflatdisc2 * qty)) * discperc2 * 0.01) for all) + ((sum(qty * purprice for all) - sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all))* invdiscperc * 0.01)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all) + sum(itemflatdisc2 * qty for all) + sum( (c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - (itemflatdisc2 * qty)) * discperc2 * 0.01 for all) + (sum(qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * (1 - (discperc * 0.01)) for all) * invdiscperc * 0.01)

objects.name: t_32
objects.visible: 1	if(sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all) + sum((itemflatdisc2 * qty) + ((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval) * discperc2 * 0.01) for all) + ((sum(qty * purprice for all) - sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all))* invdiscperc * 0.01)=0,0,1)

objects.name: t_38
objects.visible: 1	if(sum( (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), (c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax), 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ) for all) * invgstperc1  * 0.01 + sum(unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, qty, 0) ) + (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ) * gstperc *  0.01 for all)>0,1,0)

objects.name: t_12
objects.visible: 1	if(sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all) + sum((itemflatdisc2 * qty) + ((c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax + c_salestaxval - (itemflatdisc2 * qty)) * discperc2 * 0.01) for all) + ((sum(qty * purprice for all) - sum((qty * itemflatdisc) + (qty * (purprice - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01) for all))* invdiscperc * 0.01)=0,0,1)

objects.name: t_16
objects.visible: 1	if( invgstperc1 > 0 OR SUM(unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, qty, 0) ) + if( gstperc = 0 , 0, if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ), (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), (qty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 0) )) * gstperc *  0.01) for all) > 0 ,1,0)

objects.name: c_sum_invgstvalue
objects.expression: SUM(if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ), (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), (qty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 0) )) For All) * (1 - (invdiscperc * 0.01)) * invgstperc1  * 0.01

objects.name: c_sum_itemleveltax
objects.visible: 1	if( sum(unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, qty, 0) ) + (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ) * gstperc *  0.01 for all) >0,1,0)
objects.expression: sum(unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, qty, 0) ) + if( gstperc = 0 , 0, if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_amount - c_disc_b4_tax, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ), (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), (qty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 0) )) * gstperc *  0.01) for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(c_gross - c_discounts - c_flatdiscounts + c_misccharges, f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon')) + c_totalsalestax
